signIn.title: Your AltCare account
signIn.intro: Sign in with your mobile number to see your visits, prescriptions and receipts from clinics that use AltCare. We will send you a code by SMS. It is free.
signIn.sessionEnded: Your session ended. Please sign in again.

errors.otpExpired: That code has expired. Tap Send the code again.
errors.otpLocked: Too many wrong tries. Please send a new code.
errors.otpCooldown: A code was just sent. Please wait a minute before asking for another.
errors.tooMany: Too many requests. Please try again later.
errors.smsUnavailable: We cannot send SMS right now. Please try again later.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

requestAppointment.title: Request an appointment with your mobile number
requestAppointment.signInBody: To ask {name} for an appointment, sign in with your mobile number. We will send you a code by SMS. It is free.
requestAppointment.loadFailed: We could not load your account. Please try again.
requestAppointment.addYourselfBody: Tell us who the appointment is for. You can add a child too.
requestAppointment.intro: Choose a day and time of day that suits you. {name} or the clinic will confirm the exact time.
requestAppointment.dateHint: From today up to 60 days ahead.
requestAppointment.reasonNote: Keep this short. Do not include details you do not want the clinic to read before you meet.
requestAppointment.consent: I agree that {clinic} receives my basic details (name, age, gender, area and verified phone) and links its record to my AltCare profile. My medical information is not shared with any other doctor without my permission.
requestAppointment.sent: Request sent. The clinic will reply here and by SMS if they can.
requestAppointment.callBackTitle: Or ask the clinic to call you back (no sign-in)
